subtitle: 刘纪霆
headline: Multimodal Foundation Models & Embodied AI
bioMarkdown:
My research interests are broad, with a primary focus on **multimodal foundation models and embodied AI**. Recently, I have been exploring **parameter generation**, **recursive self-improvement (RSI)**, and **embodied agents**.

My recent work, [MorphAct](https://mint-sjtu.github.io/MorphAct.io/), addresses a challenge in scaling robot learning: diverse interactions can impose competing demands on shared parameters. We explore policies whose parameters adapt to the interaction context to accommodate this diversity. I am a **co-first author** of MorphAct and [Evo-Depth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14950) (accepted to NeurIPS 2026), and a co-author of [Evo-1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.04555) (CVPR 2026).

Previously, I served as a Research Assistant at the [MINT Lab](https://mint-sjtu.github.io/) at **Shanghai Jiao Tong University** and the [Miro Dynamics–HKU CGVU Joint Lab](https://hku-cg.github.io/mirod-lab/) at the **University of Hong Kong**. My work involved spatial perception for robots and cross-embodiment action retargeting for dexterous manipulation.
